articles.originalTitle: Star Wars: Has Russia's war with Ukraine gone intergalactic?
articles.originalText: Russian made an unprecedented combative move this month as one of its military satellites, the Cosmos-2612, encroached upon the orbit of Ukrainian commercial satellite, Iceye-X36, in behaviour deemed "threatening" by the US State Department. Norbert Pouzin, an orbital analyst at French space tech firm, Aldoria, described the mercenary manoeuvre as the first of its kind.
articles.originalFullText:
Russian made an unprecedented combative move this month as one of its military satellites, the Cosmos-2612, encroached upon the orbit of Ukrainian commercial satellite, Iceye-X36, in behaviour deemed "threatening" by the US State Department. Norbert Pouzin, an orbital analyst at French space tech firm, Aldoria, described the mercenary manoeuvre as the first of its kind.

Has space become a new frontier in Russia's war with Ukraine?

Russian military satellite Cosmos-2612 carried out a manoeuvre between October 15 and 18 that brought it “dangerously close” to Ukrainian commercial satellite, Iceye-X36. The move was described by US Under Secretary of State for Arms Control and International Security as "threatening".

Operated by Finnish company Iceye, Iceye-X36 is a Finnish-American civilian satellite equipped with Synthetic-aperture radar (SAR) to provide satellite images to the Ukrainian Armed Forces.

The US State Department said Russia's tactic was consistent with “in-orbit military operations”.

Analysts specialising in space surveillance have been following Cosmos-2612 since its launch in April.

"Cosmos-2612 was one of six satellites launched in total. It was immediately apparent that this wasn't a classic deployment. As soon as they took off, the satellites started changing orbit to pursue Iceye satellites,” said Norbert Pouzin, an orbital analyst at Aldoria, a French space surveillance firm.

Cosmos-2612 took off on April 6, 2026 alongside Cosmos-2609, Cosmos-2610, Cosmos-2611, Cosmos-2613 and Cosmos-2614. KeepTrack, a site specialising in satellite navigation, enables viewers to track their paths.

Orbit re-routing – as has been the case of the Cosmos satellites – is a move that consumes a lot of fuel. It’s also the first step in approaching another satellite, Pouzin explains:

"If two satellites are travelling in the same orbit, then they don’t need as much fuel to approach one another. Changing directions in space uses a lot of fuel. But once in the same orbit as another satellite, you’ve already executed the most costly move fuel-wise, if you then want to carry out an approach.”

From a kilometre to within just a few hundred metres

As the imaging data via site, Satellite Tracker, corroborates, Cosmos-2612 diverted from its original position – around 400-500 km from Iceye-X36 – to get closer to the Finnish-American satellite.

"On October 15, Cosmos-2612 was within 5 kilometres of Iceye-X36. Its position continued to narrow in on the satellite on October 16 and 17, before finally getting to within a few hundred metres and a kilometre of Iceye-X36 ,” Pouzin said.

Satellite imaging company Vantor published a photo of the two satellites on October 22, depicting their orbits withing just 1.02 kilometres of one another.

To display this content from X (Twitter), you must enable advertisement tracking and audience measurement.

Data from KeepTrack also revealed that Cosmos-2612 and Iceye-X36 later embarked on the same orbit, meaning the Russian satellite was “following” the Finnish-American satellite.

A bold move

So why did Cosmos-2612 carry out this “threatening” manoeuvre?

Given the lack of debris, it doesn’t appear that Iceye-X36 was the target of a “kinetic” attack – that is, a physical strike involving a collision or the launch of a projectile. But according to Pouzin, the manoeuvre by Cosmos-2612 could be interpreted as a form of exerting pressure on Ukraine, as it is the direct recipient of the data gathered by the Iceye satellite:

"SAR satellites have unique observation plans [Editor’s note: a schedule that coordinates how radar satellites can scan specific parts of the planet.] If an operator knows about these, then he could – for a short time – disrupt the satellite’s mission, potentially causing repercussions for ground-based or maritime operations, for example."

Cosmos-2612’s move seemed to shock Western commentators, he added:

"While Russia regularly launches military satellites in the same orbital planes as classified American military satellites; carrying out this particular kind of approach on a commercial satellite while in a low orbit is something new. Furthermore it seemed to be non-cooperative in nature: we are dealing with two actors who are not on the same side and these are satellites not operated by the same entity."

The initiative also revealed something about Russia’s capabilities, Pouzin concluded:

"The move demonstrated a certain agility by the Russian operator, a skilled knowledge of the space domain, and a very high level of mastery in this type of navigation.”
articles.fullText:
В этом месяце Россия предприняла беспрецедентный боевой шаг, поскольку один из ее военных спутников, «Космос-2612», посягнул на орбиту украинского коммерческого спутника Iceye-X36, что было сочтено «угрожающим» Госдепартаментом США. Норберт Пузин, орбитальный аналитик французской космической технологической фирмы Aldoria, описал маневр наемника как первый в своем роде.

Стало ли космос новой границей в войне России с Украиной?

Российский военный спутник «Космос-2612» провел маневр с 15 по 18 октября, который приблизил его к украинскому коммерческому спутнику «Ледье-Х36». Этот шаг был описан заместителем госсекретаря США по контролю над вооружениями и международной безопасности как «угрожающий».

Iceye-X36, управляемый финской компанией Iceye, является финско-американским гражданским спутником, оснащенным радаром с синтезированной апертурой (SAR) для предоставления спутниковых изображений Вооруженным силам Украины.

Госдепартамент США заявил, что тактика России согласуется с «на орбите военных операций».

Аналитики, специализирующиеся на космическом наблюдении, следят за «Космос-2612» с момента его запуска в апреле.

"Космос-2612 был одним из шести спутников, запущенных в общей сложности. Сразу стало очевидно, что это не классическое развертывание. Как только они взлетели, спутники начали менять орбиту, чтобы преследовать спутники Iceye, - сказал Норберт Пузин, орбитальный аналитик французской фирмы по космическому наблюдению Aldoria.

Космос-2612 взлетел 6 апреля 2026 года вместе с Космос-2609, Космос-2610, Космос-2611, Космос-2613 и Космос-2614. KeepTrack, сайт, специализирующийся на спутниковой навигации, позволяет зрителям отслеживать свои пути.

Повторная маршрутизация орбиты, как и в случае со спутниками Космоса, — это движение, которое потребляет много топлива. Это также первый шаг в сближении с другим спутником, объясняет Пузин.

"Если два спутника движутся по одной орбите, то им не нужно столько топлива, чтобы приблизиться друг к другу. Изменение направления в космосе требует много топлива. Но, оказавшись на той же орбите, что и другой спутник, вы уже выполнили самый дорогостоящий переход с использованием топлива, если вы хотите осуществить подход».

От километра до нескольких сотен метров

Как подтверждают данные, полученные с помощью спутникового трекера, «Космос-2612» отклонился от своего первоначального положения — примерно в 400-500 км от «Айсэй-Х36» — чтобы приблизиться к финско-американскому спутнику.

"15 октября "Космос-2612" находился в пределах 5 километров от "Айсей-Х36". Его положение продолжало сужаться на спутнике 16 и 17 октября, прежде чем, наконец, добраться до нескольких сотен метров и километра Iceye-X36.

Компания Vantor, занимающаяся спутниковой съемкой, опубликовала 22 октября фотографию двух спутников, на которой изображены их орбиты, расположенные всего в 1,02 км друг от друга.

Чтобы отобразить этот контент из X (Twitter), вы должны включить отслеживание рекламы и измерение аудитории.

Данные KeepTrack также показали, что «Космос-2612» и «Айсей-Х36» позже вышли на ту же орбиту, то есть российский спутник «следовал» за финско-американским спутником.

Смелый шаг

Так почему же Космос-2612 совершил этот «угрожающий» маневр?

Учитывая отсутствие обломков, не похоже, что Iceye-X36 был целью «кинетической» атаки — то есть физического удара с участием столкновения или запуска снаряда. Но, по словам Пузина, маневр Космоса-2612 можно интерпретировать как форму оказания давления на Украину, так как именно он является непосредственным получателем данных, собранных спутником "Ледниково":

"Спутники SAR имеют уникальные планы наблюдения [Примечание редактора: график, который координирует то, как радиолокационные спутники могут сканировать определенные части планеты.] Если оператор знает об этом, то он может — на короткое время — нарушить миссию спутника, что потенциально может привести к последствиям для наземных или морских операций, например».

«Космос-2612» шокировал западных комментаторов:

"В то время как Россия регулярно запускает военные спутники на тех же орбитальных плоскостях, что и американские военные спутники; осуществление такого особого подхода на коммерческом спутнике, находясь на низкой орбите, является чем-то новым. Кроме того, это, как представляется, носит некооперативный характер: мы имеем дело с двумя субъектами, которые не находятся на одной стороне, и это спутники, которыми не управляет одна и та же организация".

Инициатива также раскрыла кое-что о возможностях России, заключил Пузин:

Этот шаг продемонстрировал определенную ловкость российского оператора, квалифицированные знания космической области и очень высокий уровень мастерства в этом типе навигации.

articles.originalTitle: Tea, tunes and ties: China-Germany cultural exchanges flourish
articles.originalText: Peng Liyuan, wife of Chinese President Xi Jinping, met with Elke Budenbender, wife of German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier, for a tea reception in Beijing on Friday, as the German president is on a state visit to China from October 27 to October
articles.originalFullText:
Peng Liyuan (R), wife of Chinese President Xi Jinping, chats over tea with Elke Budenbender, wife of German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier, in Beijing, China, October 30, 2026. /China Media Group

Peng Liyuan, wife of Chinese President Xi Jinping, met with Elke Budenbender, wife of German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier, for a tea reception in Beijing on Friday, as the German president is on a state visit to China from October 27 to October 31.

Recalling her trip to Germany alongside President Xi in 2017, Peng spoke warmly of the friendship between the two countries and praised Budenbender's long-standing dedication to protecting the rights and interests of women and children.

The two watched a short film highlighting the vibrant cultural and people-to-people exchanges between the two nations.

Peng said that the two countries enjoy rich and diverse cooperation in areas including education and culture. She expressed the hope that the Chinese and German people will keep up their frequent exchanges, deepen mutual understanding and forge closer bonds of friendship.

For her part, Budenbender thanked Peng for her warm hospitality and spoke highly of Peng's contributions to cultural and people-to-people exchanges between the two countries. She said she stands ready to contribute to stronger cooperation in relevant fields and deeper friendship between the two peoples.

China-Germany cultural exchanges

China-Germany cultural exchange has grown into a rich, interlocking fabric woven through language, festivals, arts, tourism, education and more.

The Leibniz Confucius Institute in Hanover runs summer camps, remote language-partner programs and speech contests, drawing a growing number of German students to China. The Bonn-based Burg Chinese Chorus, meanwhile, brought 80 students and teachers to Yunnan, where they sang around a campfire at the Yi Torch Festival, learning more than 60 Chinese songs and experiencing local culture firsthand.

Festivals and arts carry language learning into shared public experience. Berlin's Red Town Hall has hosted the "Happy Chinese New Year" gala for 12 consecutive years, with 300 guests watching dance, folk music and martial arts. Frankfurt's Spring Festival temple fair brought Chaoshan Yingge dance and Ansai waist drums to German streets. In Duisburg, the China Festival paired concerts and film screenings with tai chi and pop-electronic music, while a Chengdu exhibition placed German and Chinese artists in the same frame to explore technology and perception.

Tourism links are being cultivated in parallel. Gansu's cultural tourism roadshow in Berlin drew more than 40 German travel industry representatives, and one German agent had already organized 38 camper vans from Türkiye to China. China's visa-free policy for German citizens, extended through 2026, has made two-way travel markedly easier.

The exchange is no longer a series of isolated events but a connected ecosystem – institutional, creative and everyday – that gives "rich and diverse" a concrete meaning.

Вспоминая свою поездку в Германию вместе с президентом Си в 2017 году, Пэн тепло отозвалась о дружбе между двумя странами и высоко оценила давнюю приверженность Буденбендера защите прав и интересов женщин и детей.

Они посмотрели короткометражный фильм, в котором освещаются яркие культурные и межличностные обмены между двумя странами.

По словам Пэна, обе страны имеют богатое и разнообразное сотрудничество в таких областях, как образование и культура. Она выразила надежду на то, что китайский и немецкий народы продолжат свои частые обмены, углубят взаимопонимание и создадут более тесные узы дружбы.

Со своей стороны, Буденбендер поблагодарила Пэн за ее теплое гостеприимство и высоко оценила вклад Пэна в культурные и межличностные обмены между двумя странами. Она заявила, что готова внести свой вклад в укрепление сотрудничества в соответствующих областях и углубление дружбы между двумя народами.

Китайско-германский культурный обмен

Культурный обмен между Китаем и Германией превратился в богатую, взаимосвязанную ткань, сплетенную через язык, фестивали, искусство, туризм, образование и многое другое.

Институт Лейбница Конфуция в Ганновере проводит летние лагеря, программы для удаленных языковых партнеров и речевые конкурсы, привлекая все большее число немецких студентов в Китай. Между тем, хор Burg Chinese Chorus из Бонна привез 80 студентов и преподавателей в Юньнань, где они пели вокруг костра на фестивале Yi Torch, изучая более 60 китайских песен и познавая местную культуру из первых рук.

Фестивали и искусства несут изучение языка в общий общественный опыт. Красная ратуша Берлина уже 12 лет подряд принимает гала-концерт «Счастливого китайского Нового года», в котором 300 гостей смотрят танцы, народную музыку и боевые искусства. Ярмарка храма Франкфуртского весеннего фестиваля принесла на немецкие улицы танцы Chaoshan Yingge и барабаны талии Ansai. В Дуйсбурге Китайский фестиваль объединил концерты и показы фильмов с тай-чи и поп-электронной музыкой, а выставка в Чэнду поместила немецких и китайских художников в один кадр, чтобы исследовать технологии и восприятие.

Параллельно развиваются туристические связи. На выставке культурного туризма Ганьсу в Берлине приняли участие более 40 представителей немецкой туристической индустрии, а один немецкий агент уже организовал 38 фургонов из Тюркие в Китай. Безвизовая политика Китая для граждан Германии, продленная до 2026 года, значительно облегчила двусторонние поездки.

Обмен уже не ряд изолированных событий, а взаимосвязанная экосистема – институциональная, творческая и повседневная – которая придает «богатому и разнообразному» конкретное значение.

articles.originalTitle: US midterms: Pope Leo XIV casts vote by mail
articles.originalText: As a US citizen, Pope Leo XIV is eligible to vote in US elections and has made use of that right with a postal ballot ahead of Tuesday's midterms. The pontiff, a Chicago native, did not reveal who he voted for.
articles.originalFullText:
Pope Leo XIV has become the first ever pontiff to vote in a United States general election after submitting a mail-in ballot ahead of November's midterms, the Vatican confirmed on Friday.

The 71-year-old US citizen, who was born in Chicago, Illinois, as Robert Francis Prevost, applied for a postal vote on October 3, according to US media.

The Holy See's press office said in a statement that the pope "has exercised his right to vote as a United States citizen" and has done so "whenever he was eligible to do so."

Indeed, records held by the Illinois State Board of Elections show that Robert Prevost has voted in every general election since 2000 except those in 2020 and 2022, including five primary elections.

Through his time as a bishop in Peru, Pope Leo also holds Peruvian citizenship and the Vatican said he had also voted whenever eligible while living in the South American country.

"The Holy Father expresses his belief in the right and the duty of citizens to participate in democratic processes," said a spokesperson in Vatican City, which itself is an absolute monarchy and does not hold political elections.

Pope Leo XIV: Do we know who the pontiff voted for?

In Tuesday's US midterm elections, all seats in the House of Representatives and about one third of the Senate are set to be contested.

US President Donald Trump's Republicans are seeking to defend narrow majorities in both chambers against a strong challenge from the Democrats.

In Illinois, voters are deciding whether to elect Governor JB Pritzker for a third term, and are also filling an open US Senate seat after the retirement of longtime Catholic Democrat Dick Durbin.

It remains unclear who Pope Leo has voted for but the pontiff has repeatedly clashed with President Trump and his administration since the start of his pontificate a year and a half ago.

Leo has criticized Trump on issues such as the Iran war, migration and press freedom and declined an invitation to the United States' 250th anniversary celebrations earlier this year.

The two are yet to meet personally but Trump has often attacked the pontiff personally, calling him "weak" and captive to the "radical left."

"I'm not afraid of the Trump administration or of speaking out loudly about the message of the Gospel, which is what the church works for," Leo responded while on a trip to Algeria in April.

"I will continue to speak out strongly against war, seeking to promote peace, promoting dialogue and multilateralism among states to find solutions to problems."

Edited by: Wesley Dockery
articles.fullText:
Папа Лев XIV стал первым понтификом, который проголосовал на всеобщих выборах в Соединенных Штатах после подачи бюллетеня по почте в преддверии ноябрьских промежуточных выборов, подтвердил Ватикан в пятницу.

71-летний гражданин США, который родился в Чикаго, штат Иллинойс, как Роберт Фрэнсис Превост, подал заявку на почтовое голосование 3 октября.

Пресс-служба Святого Престола заявила, что Папа «использовал свое право голоса в качестве гражданина Соединенных Штатов» и сделал это «когда он имел на это право».

Действительно, записи, проведенные Советом по выборам штата Иллинойс, показывают, что Роберт Превост голосовал на каждых всеобщих выборах с 2000 года, за исключением тех, которые были в 2020 и 2022 годах, включая пять первичных выборов.

Во время своего пребывания в качестве епископа в Перу Папа Лев также имеет перуанское гражданство, и Ватикан сказал, что он также голосовал, когда имел право, живя в южноамериканской стране.

«Святой Отец выражает свою веру в право и обязанность граждан участвовать в демократических процессах», — заявил представитель Ватикана, который сам является абсолютной монархией и не проводит политических выборов.

Папа Лев XIV: Мы знаем, за кого голосовал понтифик?

На промежуточных выборах в США во вторник все места в Палате представителей и около трети Сената будут оспорены.

Республиканцы президента США Дональда Трампа стремятся защитить узкое большинство в обеих палатах от сильного вызова со стороны демократов.

В Иллинойсе избиратели решают, избрать ли губернатора Джей Би Притцкера на третий срок, а также заполняют открытое место в Сенате США после выхода на пенсию давнего католического демократа Дика Дурбина.

Остается неясным, за кого проголосовал Папа Лев, но понтифик неоднократно сталкивался с президентом Трампом и его администрацией с начала его понтификата полтора года назад.

Лео раскритиковал Трампа по таким вопросам, как война в Иране, миграция и свобода прессы, и отклонил приглашение на празднование 250-летия Соединенных Штатов в начале этого года.

Эти двое еще не встретились лично, но Трамп часто нападал на понтифика лично, называя его «слабым» и пленником «радикальных левых».

«Я не боюсь администрации Трампа и не боюсь громко говорить о послании Евангелия, для чего и работает церковь», — заявил Лео во время своей поездки в Алжир.

Я буду продолжать решительно выступать против войны, стремясь содействовать миру, содействуя диалогу и многосторонности между государствами для поиска решений проблем.

Исполнитель: Wesley Dockery

Budenbender expressed heartfelt gratitude for Peng's hospitality and her appreciation for Peng's work on cultural and people-to-people exchanges between Germany and China. She stated her willingness to contribute to deepening bilateral cooperation in relevant fields and enhancing friendship between the two peoples.

articles.originalTitle: Binance crypto exchange suspends trades over North Korea-linked hack
articles.originalText: Crypto platform Binance has suspended trading following a suspected hack now linked to North Korea. The disruption has left users unable to trade on the cryptocurrency platform while the suspected breach is investigated.
articles.originalFullText:
Blockchain analysts said a North Korean hacking unit was likely behind the theft of more than $6 billion from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange.

Binance temporarily suspended deposits and withdrawals for security checks and said about $3 billion in affected assets had been frozen.

US-based blockchain intelligence firm TRM attributed the attack to TraderTraitor, which it described as an elite North Korean hacking unit.

"We make this judgment with high confidence," TRM said in a report published Thursday.

Why do analysts suspect North Korea?

TRM said attackers moved approximately $6.36 billion out of Binance wallets across 10 blockchains, most of it within about 20 minutes. It described the incident as the largest cryptocurrency theft on record.

"Several features of this attack match earlier North Korea-linked heists, including the Bybit hack," the firm said.

Bybit lost $1.5 billion in a hack in February 2025. The FBI attributed that attack to North Korea and TraderTraitor.

Jonathan Levin, co-founder and CEO of blockchain analysis company Chainalysis, also said the Binance attack was likely carried out by TraderTraitor.

Experts say North Korea uses cryptocurrency theft and other illicit cyber activities to obtain foreign currency and help fund its nuclear program despite international sanctions.

What has Binance said about the hack?

Binance did not confirm the attribution to North Korea, saying it was "working closely with our law enforcement partners to confirm the identity of the criminals and bring them to justice."

Binance said it worked to secure the affected assets and that it had located and frozen about $3 billion (€2.7 billion) so far. It did not provide information about the remaining $3.3 billion.

"Binance will cover all hacking losses," co-founder Yi He said, without providing more details about the incident.

"Rest assured that user funds are completely safe," a company spokesperson said.

Binance said its initial investigation suggested an attacker had compromised a software infrastructure engineer's laptop, gaining access to an internal service and submitting unauthorized withdrawals. The company said it had found no evidence that wallet private keys had leaked.

Tether froze around $1.6 billion in its USDT currency, according to CEO Paolo Ardoino, and Circle froze some $800 million-worth of USDC, boss Jeremy Allaire said.

The news of the possible hack sent Bitcoin's value tumbling by 3.2% on Thursday evening, dropping below $79,000.

Who is Binance ex-CEO Zhao?

Zhao, who founded the Binance platform in 2017, said "as a shareholder, I expect all user funds will be fully covered."

He stepped down as CEO after pleading guilty in 2023. to failing to prevent money laundering on his platform. US President Donald Trump pardoned him in 2025.

Zhao and Binance have been key supporters of cryptocurrency ventures by US President Donald Trump and his family.

Edited by Sean Sinico and Karl Sexton
articles.fullText:
Аналитики Blockchain заявили, что северокорейское хакерское подразделение, вероятно, стоит за кражей более 6 миллиардов долларов от Binance, крупнейшей в мире криптовалютной биржи.

Binance временно приостановила депозиты и снятие средств для проверки безопасности и заявила, что около 3 миллиардов долларов в пострадавших активах были заморожены.

Американская блокчейн-разведывательная фирма TRM приписала атаку TraderTraitor, который она описала как элитное северокорейское хакерское подразделение.

«Мы выносим это решение с высокой степенью уверенности», — говорится в отчете TRM, опубликованном в четверг.

Почему аналитики подозревают Северную Корею?

По данным TRM, злоумышленники перевели около $6,36 млрд из кошельков Binance через 10 блокчейнов, большинство из которых было создано в течение 20 минут. Он описал инцидент как крупнейшую кражу криптовалюты за всю историю.

«Несколько особенностей этой атаки совпадают с более ранними ограблениями, связанными с Северной Кореей, включая взлом Bybit», — говорится в заявлении компании.

Bybit потерял 1,5 миллиарда долларов в результате взлома в феврале 2025 года. ФБР приписывает эту атаку Северной Корее и предателю-трейдеру.

Джонатан Левин, соучредитель и генеральный директор аналитической компании Chainalysis, также сказал, что атака Binance, вероятно, была проведена TraderTraitor.

Эксперты говорят, что Северная Корея использует кражу криптовалюты и другие незаконные кибер-деятельность для получения иностранной валюты и финансирования своей ядерной программы, несмотря на международные санкции.

Что сказал Binance о взломе?

Binance не подтвердила причастность Северной Кореи, заявив, что она «тесно сотрудничает с нашими партнерами по правоохранительным органам, чтобы подтвердить личность преступников и привлечь их к ответственности».

Binance заявила, что работает над обеспечением безопасности затронутых активов, и что она обнаружила и заморозила около 3 миллиардов долларов (2,7 миллиарда евро). Он не предоставил информацию об оставшихся $3,3 млрд.

«Binance покроет все потери от взлома», - сказал соучредитель Yi He, не предоставив более подробной информации об инциденте.

«Уверены, что средства пользователей полностью безопасны», — сказал представитель компании.

Binance заявила, что ее первоначальное расследование показало, что злоумышленник взломал ноутбук инженера-программиста, получив доступ к внутренней службе и представив несанкционированные изъятия. Компания заявила, что не нашла никаких доказательств утечки личных ключей кошелька.

По словам генерального директора Паоло Ардоино, Tether заморозил около 1,6 миллиарда долларов в своей валюте USDT, а Circle заморозил около 800 миллионов долларов USDC, сказал босс Джереми Аллэр.

Новость о возможном взломе привела к тому, что стоимость биткоина упала на 3,2% в четверг вечером, опустившись ниже $79 000.

Кто такой бывший генеральный директор Binance Чжао?

Чжао, который основал платформу Binance в 2017 году, сказал: «Как акционер, я ожидаю, что все средства пользователей будут полностью покрыты».

Он ушел с поста генерального директора после признания себя виновным в 2023 году. Неспособность предотвратить отмывание денег на своей платформе. Президент США Дональд Трамп помиловал его в 2025 году.

Чжао и Binance были ключевыми сторонниками криптовалютных предприятий президента США Дональда Трампа и его семьи.

Под редакцией Шона Синико и Карла Секстона

articles.originalTitle: NPR special: 5 takeaways from a year of listening to swing voters
articles.originalText: Every election, there is a crucial sliver of voters who help determine which candidates win. Here are five takeaways from a year of listening to voters who backed Biden in 2020 and then Trump in 2024.
articles.originalFullText:
Every election, there is a crucial sliver of voters who help determine which candidates win.

These are voters who bounce from one side to the other — the rare swing voters.

And all throughout 2026, NPR has had a front-row seat to how these folks think, listening in as voters in different swing states reflect on President Trump, the political issues that matter to them, and who they might vote for going forward.

In this case, these voters supported Joe Biden in 2020 and then swung to backing Trump in 2024.

They all participated in the Swing Voter Project, which hosts online focus groups every month. They are run by messaging firm Engagious and market research recruiting firm Nelson Recruiting. NPR is a partner on the project.

So just ahead of Election Day, what have we learned from swing voters this year? Here are five takeaways:

- These Biden-to-Trump voters quickly soured on the president

- Voters are able to draw a direct line from Trump's decisions to their feelings about the economy

- It's not like Democrats are popular either!

- There appears to be a convergence among voters on the left and right in support of economic populism

- There's broad concern about artificial intelligence and the proliferation of data centers

Click the audio player above to listen to a special, hour-long discussion about these takeaways and the voters.

This special — "Swing voters and the issues that matter" — was edited by Ben Swasey and produced by Lexie Schapitl.

На каждых выборах есть решающая часть избирателей, которые помогают определить, какие кандидаты победят.

Это избиратели, которые перескакивают с одной стороны на другую — редкие колеблющиеся избиратели.

И на протяжении всего 2026 года NPR занимала первое место в ряду тех, кто думает, слушая, как избиратели в разных штатах размышляют о президенте Трампе, о политических проблемах, которые имеют для них значение, и о том, за кого они могут голосовать.

В этом случае эти избиратели поддержали Джо Байдена в 2020 году, а затем в 2024 году поддержали Трампа.

Все они участвовали в проекте Swing Voter Project, который ежемесячно проводит онлайн-фокус-группы. Они управляются фирмой обмена сообщениями Engagious и фирмой по подбору персонала для маркетинговых исследований Nelson Recruiting. NPR является партнером проекта.

Итак, перед Днем выборов, что мы узнали от избирателей в этом году? Вот пять выводов:

Эти избиратели Байдена и Трампа быстро напали на президента

Избиратели могут провести прямую линию от решений Трампа к их чувствам по поводу экономики.

- Не похоже, чтобы демократы были популярны!

- Похоже, что среди избирателей слева и справа наблюдается сближение в поддержку экономического популизма.

Существует широкая озабоченность по поводу искусственного интеллекта и распространения центров обработки данных.

articles.originalTitle: South Africa braces for AGOA review amid US trade talks
articles.originalText: South Africa is preparing for possible changes to its eligibility under the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA), while keeping trade negotiations with the United States ongoing, Foreign Minister Ronald Lamola said Wednesday.
articles.originalFullText:
South Africa is preparing for possible changes to its eligibility under the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA), while keeping trade negotiations with the United States ongoing, Foreign Minister Ronald Lamola said Wednesday.

Washington conducts annual reviews of countries participating in the preferential trade program, with the Department of Trade, Industry and Competition expecting the latest findings on November 2.

Speaking at the launch of the Global Africa Research Initiative at the University of the Witwatersrand in Johannesburg, Lamola underscored the importance of maintaining economic ties with the United States, one of South Africa's biggest trading partners. He noted that bilateral trade supports thousands of jobs in the country.

Adding that Pretoria remained committed to negotiations towards mutually beneficial trade arrangements while preparing for various possible outcomes.

"Dialogue is indispensable, regardless of how difficult the atmosphere may be. We are, however, preparing for any eventuality concerning AGOA," Lamola said.

The minister said South Africa's foreign policy must be closely aligned with its economic priorities, including strengthening existing trade relationships, accessing new markets and securing favorable conditions for its exports.

He also pointed to BRICS as an important platform for broadening South Africa's trade and investment partnerships, adding that international engagements must deliver tangible economic gains for the country's people.

Южная Африка готовится к возможным изменениям в своем праве в соответствии с Законом о росте и возможностях Африки (AGOA), продолжая торговые переговоры с Соединенными Штатами, заявил в среду министр иностранных дел Рональд Ламола.

Вашингтон проводит ежегодные обзоры стран, участвующих в программе преференциальной торговли, при этом Департамент торговли, промышленности и конкуренции ожидает последних результатов 2 ноября.

Выступая на открытии Глобальной исследовательской инициативы по Африке в Университете Витватерсранда в Йоханнесбурге, Ламола подчеркнул важность поддержания экономических связей с Соединенными Штатами, одним из крупнейших торговых партнеров Южной Африки. Он отметил, что двусторонняя торговля поддерживает тысячи рабочих мест в стране.

Кроме того, Претория по-прежнему привержена переговорам о взаимовыгодных торговых соглашениях при подготовке к различным возможным результатам.

"Диалог необходим, независимо от того, насколько сложной может быть атмосфера. Однако мы готовимся к любым возможным событиям, связанным с AGOA, - сказал Ламола.

По словам министра, внешняя политика ЮАР должна быть тесно связана с экономическими приоритетами, включая укрепление существующих торговых отношений, выход на новые рынки и обеспечение благоприятных условий для экспорта.

Он также отметил, что БРИКС является важной платформой для расширения торгового и инвестиционного партнерства Южной Африки, добавив, что международные обязательства должны принести ощутимую экономическую выгоду для народа страны.

articles.originalTitle: Germany news: Merz hopes for Korean reunification at DMZ
articles.originalText: Chancellor Friedrich Merz has expressed hope for Korean reunification during a visit to the heavily fortified border. Meanwhile, President Steinmeier has held talks with China's Xi Jinping in Beijing.
articles.originalFullText:
What you need to know

-

Chancellor Friedrich Merz visits the demilitarized zone between North and South Korea

-

- Chinese President Xi Jinping lauds 'new chapter' in Germany ties while meeting with President Steinmeier

- Berlin event set to mark the 65th anniversary of West Germany and Turkey's agreement on 'guest workers'

Here are the leading headlines from and about Germany on Friday, October 30:

Merz at DMZ says he hopes Korea can reunify like Germany did

German Chancellor Friedrich Merz on Friday visited the Panmunjom truce village at the demilitarized zone (DMZ) separating North and South Korea, briefly standing on the North Korean side inside the barracks.

North and South Korea have been divided since the end of hostilities in the Korean War in 1953, with a border running across the peninsula.

In remarks to reporters, Merz recalled Germany's reunification 36 years ago.

"Let us hope that Korea too gets the chance one day to regain state unity," he said.

"You can also notice it here at this place, how much a country suffers from division and how strong the desire is for reunification, at least in this part of the Korean Peninsula," he said, adding that he had been asked about Germany's reunification experience while visiting Seoul.

North Korea, however, has backed away in recent years from diplomacy with the South, having officially removed language calling for reunification from its constitution while changing the South's status to that of a "hostile state."

Munich: Vandals smash Manchester United memorial

A glass cabinet containing memorabilia linked to the 1958 Munich Air Disaster, in which eight Manchester United footballers lost their lives, was smashed and plundered in the Munich suburb of Trudering this week.

The display case on Manchesterplatz forms part of a memorial commemorating the tragedy which occurred when the United team made a refueling stop in Munich while on the way back from a European Cup game in Belgrade, Serbia, on February 6, 1958.

The plane struggled to take off again in the wintery conditions at the old Munich-Riem airport to the east of the city center and, on the third attempt, ploughed off the end of the runway and into a house. Of the 44 people on board, 23 were killed, including eight United players, several journalists and two crew members.

The crash site has become a place of pilgrimage for United supporters and, in 2020, the cabinet was installed on the initiative of the Red Docs Munich – a local Bayern Munich fan club – to house the various memorabilia and tributes left by visitors.

Munich police said the cabinet was broken into on Monday morning between 8 a.m. and 1 p.m. local time (07:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. UTC), with the unknown perpetrators making off with a glass sculpture and several medals.

"They don't understand the damage that they've caused," Ifty Ahmed, chairman of the Manchester Munich Memorial Foundation (MMMF), told the BBC, adding: "Whatever they've taken from inside the showcase, they haven't taken our memories."

The Red Docs Munich arranged for replacement glass to be installed on the same day. The MMMF said Manchester United had offered to pay for the repairs but said the foundation had covered the costs itself.

The joint commemoration of the 1958 disaster and the maintenance of the memorial site has produced extensive and friendly relations between Bayern Munich and Manchester United, who will meet in the Champions League in January.

German politicians have been slow to respond as they wait to see who is likely to comprise the next coalition. Many are also hoping for a government without religious hardliners.

Read the full story here

Carmaker Audi's profits plunge in 3rd quarter

Profits of German luxury car brand Audi for the third quarter came plunged 87% year-on-year to €95 million ($106 million), the Volkswagen subsidiary reported on Friday. This is a drop from €718 million seen in the same quarter last year.

The drop comes amid weak demand in China, and US tariffs.

"Market and competitive conditions have become significantly more difficult in the third quarter," Audi chief financial officer Jürgen Rittersberger told journalists on a call.

"That all shows that we need to intensify measures and set clear priorities," he added.

Overall in the first nine months of 2026, Audi's profits have dropped 41% to €1.22 billion.

The carmaker trimmed its 2026 profit outlook down to 3 to 5% for the year, down from the previous 5 to 7%.

Audi's sluggish numbers represent more bad news for the 10-brand Volkswagen Group, which on Thursday reported its largest quarterly loss in more than a decade, at nearly €6 billion.

Holocaust 'stumbling stone' ban to remain in Heidenau

A ban on new Stolpersteine ("stumbling stones") to commemorate victims of the Holocaust in the eastern German town of Heidenau will be upheld after five petitions against the measure were thrown out.

Local councilors from Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democratic Union (CDU) and the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) voted together in September to pass the controversial ban on new stones being laid in the town in Saxony, near Dresden.

Petitions against the measure were submitted from across Germany — as well as one from the Netherlands — calling for victims of the Nazi regime to continue to be remembered in Heidenau by way of the small metal plaques embedded in pavements.

"Not everybody has to like the stumbling stones but everyone should have the possibility to lay one in public," one councilor, Michael Schürer, told Germany's Catholic News Agency (KNA), criticizing the rejection of the petitions.

The initiators of the Heidenau ban had argued that, while remembering Holocaust victims remains essential, the placement of Stolpersteine leads to "passersby walking over or even stepping onto the names of the victims." They suggested honoring victims at a local cemetery instead.

The decision of the local Heidenau CDU to join forces with the AfD to pass the motion sparked a nationwide scandal and furthered the debate over the conservatives' commitment to the political "firewall" against the far right.

Chinese President Xi lauds 'new chapter' of Germany-China ties

Ahead of talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping on Friday, German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier lauded China's role as a global technological and economic power, while emphasizing the responsibility that comes along with it.

"We both bear responsibility for the international order and for the conditions under which states in this world maintain and shape their relations," Steinmeier said.

President Xi praised what he called an "all-dimensional strategic partnership" between China and Germany, calling for new cooperation based on stability and mutual benefit.

"This new paradigm sends a positive signal to the world: we favor openness over closure, and cooperation over confrontation," Xi said during opening remarks, emphasizing the start of a "new chapter" in Germany-China ties.

Xi added that he hopes Germany and the European Union will stick by a "rational, pragmatic and friendly" China policy, adding that cooperation outweighs competition and consensus outweighs differences in China-EU relations.

The EU has a massive trade deficit with China, which reached €360 billion ($400.4 billion) last year and is set to exceed that level this year.

Brussels has accused China of unfair economic practices, saying its state subsidies for its industries are creating an unlevel playing field. Germany with its export based economy, the EU's largest, is hit hard by China's manufacturing surplus flooding global markets.

Industry groups say the surge in imports from China is leading to an increasing number of factory closures in the bloc.

Nonetheless, "differences and problems can always be resolved," the Chinese president said.

IN DEPTH: 65 years on, many Turkish 'guest workers' in Germany face poverty

On October 30, 1961, West Germany and Turkey signed an agreement allowing the temporary recruitment of workers. Sixty-five years on, many so-called "guest workers" cannot live from their pensions.

Learn more about how "guest workers" are struggling as they reach retirement age in this in depth report by Oliver Pieper.

German president in Beijing addresses trade tensions with China

While German Chancellor Friedrich Merz in South Korea on Friday called for a better rule-based trade order, President Frank-Walter Steinmeier was in the Chinese capital in a bid to smooth out trade disagreements.

In Beijing, Steinmeier called for preserving the "win-win principle" characterizing Sino-German relations, borrowing from the expression "win-win cooperation," one of the most frequently used phrases in Chinese foreign policy statements.

Germany's economic ties with China have gone through a shock in recent years, with Chinese manufacturing growing into sectors once dominated by German firms, and Chinese electric cars taking over market share.

At the start of a meeting with Chinese Premier Li Qiang, Steinmeier cited a recent deal limiting exports of Chinese hybrid cars to the EU in exchange for select tariff cuts on EU exports to China as an example of a "a way to find solutions."

Steinmeier also brought up Germany's growing trade deficit with China, which grew to nearly €90 billion ($100 billion) last year.

Germany has long resisted tougher action against China, fearing retaliation. But rising pressure on key industries has pushed Berlin to seek stronger EU trade-defense powers to protect its industrial base.

Steinmeier said Germany would work to solve trade problems with China. "We are coming with the intention of maintaining and strengthening the framework for good economic exchange between our two countries," Steinmeier said.

Later in the day, the German president, who occupies a largely ceremonial role without policymaking power, was also recieved by an honor guard alongside Chinese President Xi Jinping.

Merz in Seoul calls for new trade order, says supply chains cannot become 'political pawns'

During his final day of a whirlwind Asia tour this week, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz told the Asia-Pacific Conference of German Business in Seoul on Friday that Germany and Europe are ready to cooperate with Asian economies to foster a rules-based economic order.

Merz said the European Union is ready to take the lead in shaping a better deal for countries in Asia feeling the pressure of a destabilized rules-based trade order.

"Competition between the US and China is ramping up. Tariffs, technological decoupling strategies and a tough race for critical raw materials and new technologies are fundamentally changing the rules of our global economy," Merz said.

"These conflicts and systemic shifts in power patterns concern us all. They particularly concern economically aspiring partners in the Indo-Pacific, as well as in Germany and in Europe."

During stops in Singapore and Japan this week, Merz pushed for free trade partnerships and greater European cooperation with Asian economies.

In Singapore on Wednesday, Merz called for a free trade agreement between the EU and the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), a sweeping multilateral free trade agreement connecting the Asia Pacific and the Americas.

The UK is the single European signatory, albeit outside of the EU bloc. The US pulled out during the first administration President Donald Trump in 2017, scuttling the original version, the Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP).

"We want to offer opportunities beyond bilateral agreements,"he said in Seoul on Friday.

"We are resolutely joining forces against unilateralism, autocratic power politics and violations of international law," Merz added.

"When supply chains become political pawns, when access to key technologies is obstructed or when efforts to secure raw materials resemble displays of power rather than fair partnerships, this jeopardizes growth, prosperity and ultimately the security of entire regions."

Merz also tried to allay concerns about EU protectionism under the "Made in Europe" scheme intended to protect carmakers.

"There is a fear that we might be facing a new wave of European protectionism - that we are closing ourselves off from other nations," Merz said.

"I take these concerns very seriously. I will carry them back not just to Berlin, but also to Brussels, and I will certainly raise the fact that these concerns were expressed to me quite forcefully here," he added.

Citing Germany as an example, South Korean Prime Minister Han Seong Sook told the conference "German companies are using Korea as a central hub to expand their presence in the Asia-Pacific region."

Additional reporting by Nina Haase

IN DEPTH: Germany seeks new head of state

The question of who should become Germany's new president is becoming pressing.

Many want to see Germany's first female head of state. Chancellor Friedrich Merz is keeping his cards close to his chest.

Read DW's full report on who may be the next German president.

Welcome to our coverage

Good morning from the DW newsroom in Bonn.

Germany's chancellor and president were both in Asia this week, with Chancellor Friedrich Merz calling for more robust trade ties with middle powers and President Frank-Walter Steinmeier focusing on diplomacy during a multi-day visit to China.

On Friday, Merz spoke at a German-South Korean business conference in Seoul, while Steinmeier is set to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

Keep reading for the latest updates from Germany.

Overall in the first nine months of 2026, Audi's profits have dropped 41% to €1.22 billion.

The carmaker trimmed its 2026 profit outlook down to 3 to 5% for the year, down from the previous 5 to 7%.

Audi's sluggish numbers represent more bad news for the 10-brand Volkswagen Group, which on Thursday reported its largest quarterly loss in more than a decade, at nearly €6 billion.

Holocaust 'stumbling stone' ban to remain in Heidenau

A ban on new Stolpersteine ("stumbling stones") to commemorate victims of the Holocaust in the eastern German town of Heidenau will be upheld after five petitions against the measure were thrown out.

Local councilors from Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democratic Union (CDU) and the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) voted together in September to pass the controversial ban on new stones being laid in the town in Saxony, near Dresden.

Petitions against the measure were submitted from across Germany — as well as one from the Netherlands — calling for victims of the Nazi regime to continue to be remembered in Heidenau by way of the small metal plaques embedded in pavements.

"Not everybody has to like the stumbling stones but everyone should have the possibility to lay one in public," one councilor, Michael Schürer, told Germany's Catholic News Agency (KNA), criticizing the rejection of the petitions.

The initiators of the Heidenau ban had argued that, while remembering Holocaust victims remains essential, the placement of Stolpersteine leads to "passersby walking over or even stepping onto the names of the victims." They suggested honoring victims at a local cemetery instead.

The decision of the local Heidenau CDU to join forces with the AfD to pass the motion sparked a nationwide scandal and furthered the debate over the conservatives' commitment to the political "firewall" against the far right.

Chinese President Xi lauds 'new chapter' of Germany-China ties

Ahead of talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping on Friday, German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier lauded China's role as a global technological and economic power, while emphasizing the responsibility that comes along with it.

"We both bear responsibility for the international order and for the conditions under which states in this world maintain and shape their relations," Steinmeier said.

President Xi praised what he called an "all-dimensional strategic partnership" between China and Germany, calling for new cooperation based on stability and mutual benefit.

"This new paradigm sends a positive signal to the world: we favor openness over closure, and cooperation over confrontation," Xi said during opening remarks, emphasizing the start of a "new chapter" in Germany-China ties.

Xi added that he hopes Germany and the European Union will stick by a "rational, pragmatic and friendly" China policy, adding that cooperation outweighs competition and consensus outweighs differences in China-EU relations.

The EU has a massive trade deficit with China, which reached €360 billion ($400.4 billion) last year and is set to exceed that level this year.

Brussels has accused China of unfair economic practices, saying its state subsidies for its industries are creating an unlevel playing field. Germany with its export based economy, the EU's largest, is hit hard by China's manufacturing surplus flooding global markets.

Industry groups say the surge in imports from China is leading to an increasing number of factory closures in the bloc.

Nonetheless, "differences and problems can always be resolved," the Chinese president said.

IN DEPTH: 65 years on, many Turkish 'guest workers' in Germany face poverty

On October 30, 1961, West Germany and Turkey signed an agreement allowing the temporary recruitment of workers. Sixty-five years on, many so-called "guest workers" cannot live from their pensions.

Learn more about how "guest workers" are struggling as they reach retirement age in this in depth report by Oliver Pieper.

German president in Beijing addresses trade tensions with China

While German Chancellor Friedrich Merz in South Korea on Friday called for a better rule-based trade order, President Frank-Walter Steinmeier was in the Chinese capital in a bid to smooth out trade disagreements.

In Beijing, Steinmeier called for preserving the "win-win principle" characterizing Sino-German relations, borrowing from the expression "win-win cooperation," one of the most frequently used phrases in Chinese foreign policy statements.

Germany's economic ties with China have gone through a shock in recent years, with Chinese manufacturing growing into sectors once dominated by German firms, and Chinese electric cars taking over market share.

At the start of a meeting with Chinese Premier Li Qiang, Steinmeier cited a recent deal limiting exports of Chinese hybrid cars to the EU in exchange for select tariff cuts on EU exports to China as an example of a "a way to find solutions."

Steinmeier also brought up Germany's growing trade deficit with China, which grew to nearly €90 billion ($100 billion) last year.

Germany has long resisted tougher action against China, fearing retaliation. But rising pressure on key industries has pushed Berlin to seek stronger EU trade-defense powers to protect its industrial base.

Steinmeier said Germany would work to solve trade problems with China. "We are coming with the intention of maintaining and strengthening the framework for good economic exchange between our two countries," Steinmeier said.

Later in the day, the German president, who occupies a largely ceremonial role without policymaking power, was also recieved by an honor guard alongside Chinese President Xi Jinping.

Merz in Seoul calls for new trade order, says supply chains cannot become 'political pawns'

During his final day of a whirlwind Asia tour this week, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz told the Asia-Pacific Conference of German Business in Seoul on Friday that Germany and Europe are ready to cooperate with Asian economies to foster a rules-based economic order.

Merz said the European Union is ready to take the lead in shaping a better deal for countries in Asia feeling the pressure of a destabilized rules-based trade order.

"Competition between the US and China is ramping up. Tariffs, technological decoupling strategies and a tough race for critical raw materials and new technologies are fundamentally changing the rules of our global economy," Merz said.

"These conflicts and systemic shifts in power patterns concern us all. They particularly concern economically aspiring partners in the Indo-Pacific, as well as in Germany and in Europe."

During stops in Singapore and Japan this week, Merz pushed for free trade partnerships and greater European cooperation with Asian economies.

In Singapore on Wednesday, Merz called for a free trade agreement between the EU and the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), a sweeping multilateral free trade agreement connecting the Asia Pacific and the Americas.

The UK is the single European signatory, albeit outside of the EU bloc. The US pulled out during the first administration President Donald Trump in 2017, scuttling the original version, the Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP).

"We want to offer opportunities beyond bilateral agreements,"he said in Seoul on Friday.

"We are resolutely joining forces against unilateralism, autocratic power politics and violations of international law," Merz added.

"When supply chains become political pawns, when access to key technologies is obstructed or when efforts to secure raw materials resemble displays of power rather than fair partnerships, this jeopardizes growth, prosperity and ultimately the security of entire regions."

Merz also tried to allay concerns about EU protectionism under the "Made in Europe" scheme intended to protect carmakers.

"There is a fear that we might be facing a new wave of European protectionism - that we are closing ourselves off from other nations," Merz said.

"I take these concerns very seriously. I will carry them back not just to Berlin, but also to Brussels, and I will certainly raise the fact that these concerns were expressed to me quite forcefully here," he added.

Citing Germany as an example, South Korean Prime Minister Han Seong Sook told the conference "German companies are using Korea as a central hub to expand their presence in the Asia-Pacific region."

Additional reporting by Nina Haase

IN DEPTH: Germany seeks new head of state

The question of who should become Germany's new president is becoming pressing.

Many want to see Germany's first female head of state. Chancellor Friedrich Merz is keeping his cards close to his chest.

Read DW's full report on who may be the next German president.

Welcome to our coverage

Good morning from the DW newsroom in Bonn.

Germany's chancellor and president were both in Asia this week, with Chancellor Friedrich Merz calling for more robust trade ties with middle powers and President Frank-Walter Steinmeier focusing on diplomacy during a multi-day visit to China.

On Friday, Merz spoke at a German-South Korean business conference in Seoul, while Steinmeier is set to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

Keep reading for the latest updates from Germany.

articles.originalTitle: How the CPC charts path for full and rigorous Party self-governance
articles.originalText: The 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held its fifth plenary session from Monday to Thursday in Beijing, adopting a resolution on persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance, which also highlighted the importance of anti-corruption.
articles.originalFullText:
People might ask: Does it really matter if an official accepts a dinner invitation? The answer can be found in the numbers.

Cases involving improper dining and drinking accounted for 18.2% of all violations related to hedonism and extravagance investigated during September, according to China's top anti-corruption authorities.

What lie behind a simple meal are issues concerning an official's sense of discipline, their conception of power and their approach to conduct. Addressing these seemingly minor details is therefore central to China's full and rigorous Party self-governance, ensuring that integrity is maintained at every level.

How the Communist Party of China (CPC) combats corruption is one of the topics that has attracted the greatest interest among participants in CGTN's Ask China initiative.

The 20th Central Committee of the CPC held its fifth plenary session from Monday to Thursday in Beijing, adopting a resolution on persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance, which also highlighted the importance of combating corruption.

Fighting corruption to safeguard public interests

The fight against corruption is not simply about punishing officials who break the rules. It is also about strengthening the Party's ability to govern and ensuring that public power serves the interests of the people.

The endeavors to advance full and rigorous governance over the Party in the new era have broken new ground in the self-reform of the century-old Party and brought about historic achievements and transformations in the cause of the Party and the country, according to a communique of the session released on Thursday.

Zhang Fuhai, deputy secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CPC, said the CPC has outlined four areas of focus for steadfastly pursuing a distinctive Chinese path to combating corruption at a press conference on the guiding principles from the fifth plenary session of the 20th CPC Central Committee.

Among them, Zhang stressed strengthening efforts to tackle corruption in sectors where power is concentrated and large amounts of funds and resources are involved, with a focus on cases involving intertwined political and economic interests, collusion between officials and businesses, and the infiltration of political circles by capital.

Zhang also said greater attention will be paid to uncovering new and concealed forms of corruption, while misconduct and corruption affecting people at the grassroots level will be addressed on a regular basis.

The scale of the campaign is reflected in the figures. Since the 18th CPC National Congress in 2012, discipline inspection and supervisory organs across the country have filed 8.105 million cases and punished 7.922 million people, according to Zhang.

Punishment, however, is only one part of the effort. China's approach also seeks to address the institutional and ideological roots of corruption.

Xie Maosong, a senior researcher at the National Institute of Strategic Studies under Tsinghua University, said the CPC regards corruption as a major threat to its governing foundation and considers combating it a long-term task that requires both determination and institutional safeguards.

"A central principle of this approach is to address corruption through three interconnected measures: making officials afraid to engage in corruption, making it impossible for them to do so and fostering an unwillingness to do so," said Xie.

Specifically, the first relies on strict enforcement and credible deterrence, the second focuses on improving institutions, tightening oversight and placing checks on the exercise of power, while the third emphasizes education, ethical awareness and a stronger commitment to public service, added Xie.

Turning organizational strength into effective governance

With China in its 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030), the question of how to translate the CPC's organizational strength into effective governance and development momentum has taken on added significance.

The CPC has more than 100 million members and over 5.4 million primary-level Party organizations, giving it a powerful advantage unmatched by any other political party in the world, said Huang Jianfa, deputy head of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee.

But the size of an organization alone does not guarantee effective governance. The key lies in how its members are selected, managed, trained and held accountable.

Full and rigorous Party self-governance requires strict management of officials, according to the communique. It calls for building a high-caliber cadre workforce with strong political commitment, professional competence, sound work styles and strict discipline.

Huang outlined five priorities in strengthening cadre management, ranging from upholding the right criteria for selecting and appointing officials to strengthening the officials' ability to take initiative and deliver results.

These priorities reflect a broader recognition that China's development goals require not only sound policies but also officials capable of implementing them effectively.

Xia Lu, an expert on Party building at Renmin University of China, said, "The quality of the ruling party directly shapes a country's capacity to achieve modernization, forming a clear causal chain: Party self-governance leads to effective governance, which delivers development, paves the way for modernization and ultimately brings about national rejuvenation."

Xia also said a country's long-term development requires organizational continuity, as infrastructure, industrialization, education, technological upgrading and poverty reduction often depend on policies that endure across decades rather than the lifespan of a single administration.

So the selection and evaluation of officials matters enormously, as development depends on a bureaucracy capable of learning, implementing and adapting, not merely one that follows procedures, Xia said.
articles.title: Как КПК прокладывает путь к полному и строгому партийному самоуправлению
articles.text: 20-й ЦК КПК с понедельника по четверг в Пекине провел свое пятое пленарное заседание, приняв резолюцию о настойчивости в полном и жестком партийном самоуправлении, в которой также подчеркнул важность борьбы с коррупцией.
articles.fullText:
Люди могут спросить: действительно ли важно, если чиновник принимает приглашение на ужин? Ответ можно найти в цифрах.

Случаи, связанные с ненадлежащим питанием и употреблением алкоголя, составили 18,2% всех нарушений, связанных с гедонизмом и экстравагантностью, расследованных в сентябре, по данным ведущих антикоррупционных органов Китая.

За простой едой стоят вопросы, касающиеся чувства дисциплины чиновника, его представления о власти и его подхода к поведению. Поэтому решение этих, казалось бы, незначительных деталей является центральным для полного и строгого партийного самоуправления Китая, обеспечивая сохранение целостности на всех уровнях.

Как Коммунистическая партия Китая (КПК) борется с коррупцией - одна из тем, которая привлекла наибольший интерес среди участников инициативы CGTN Ask China.

20-й ЦК КПК с понедельника по четверг в Пекине провел свое пятое пленарное заседание, приняв резолюцию о настойчивости в полном и жестком партийном самоуправлении, в которой также была подчеркнута важность борьбы с коррупцией.

Борьба с коррупцией для защиты общественных интересов

Борьба с коррупцией заключается не только в наказании чиновников, нарушающих правила. Речь идет также об укреплении способности партии управлять и обеспечении того, чтобы общественная власть служила интересам народа.

Стремление к продвижению полного и строгого управления партией в новую эпоху заложило новую почву в самореформе вековой партии и привело к историческим достижениям и преобразованиям в деле партии и страны, говорится в коммюнике сессии, опубликованном в четверг.

Чжан Фухай, заместитель секретаря Центральной комиссии по проверке дисциплины КПК, сказал, что КПК обозначил четыре направления для неуклонного продвижения отличительного китайского пути борьбы с коррупцией на пресс-конференции по руководящим принципам с пятой пленарной сессии 20-го ЦК КПК.

Среди них Чжан подчеркнул усиление усилий по борьбе с коррупцией в секторах, где сосредоточена власть и задействованы большие объемы средств и ресурсов, с акцентом на дела, связанные с переплетенными политическими и экономическими интересами, сговором между чиновниками и бизнесом и проникновением капитала в политические круги.

Чжан также сказал, что больше внимания будет уделяться раскрытию новых и скрытых форм коррупции, в то время как проступки и коррупция, затрагивающие людей на низовом уровне, будут рассматриваться на регулярной основе.

Масштаб кампании отражен в цифрах. По данным Чжана, начиная с 18-го Национального конгресса КПК в 2012 году органы контроля и надзора за дисциплиной по всей стране подали 8,105 млн дел и наказали 7,922 млн человек.

Наказание – это только часть усилий. Китайский подход также направлен на устранение институциональных и идеологических корней коррупции.

Се Маосон, старший научный сотрудник Национального института стратегических исследований при Университете Цинхуа, сказал, что КПК рассматривает коррупцию как серьезную угрозу своей руководящей базе и считает борьбу с ней долгосрочной задачей, которая требует как решимости, так и институциональных гарантий.

«Основной принцип этого подхода заключается в борьбе с коррупцией с помощью трех взаимосвязанных мер: заставить чиновников бояться заниматься коррупцией, сделать это невозможным для них и способствовать нежеланию делать это», - сказал Се.

В частности, первый опирается на строгое правоприменение и надежное сдерживание, второй фокусируется на совершенствовании институтов, ужесточении надзора и проверке осуществления власти, в то время как третий подчеркивает образование, этическую осведомленность и более сильную приверженность государственной службе.

Превращение организационной силы в эффективное управление

В период 15-й пятилетки (2026-2030 годы) вопрос о том, как преобразовать организационную мощь КПК в эффективное управление и динамику развития, приобрел дополнительное значение.

У КПК более 100 миллионов членов и более 5,4 миллиона партийных организаций первичного уровня, что дает ей мощное преимущество, не имеющее аналогов в любой другой политической партии в мире, - сказал Хуан Цзяньфа, заместитель главы департамента организации ЦК КПК.

Но размер одной организации не гарантирует эффективного управления. Ключ заключается в том, как его члены выбираются, управляются, обучаются и привлекаются к ответственности.

Полное и строгое партийное самоуправление требует строгого управления должностными лицами. Он призывает к созданию высококвалифицированной кадровой рабочей силы с сильной политической приверженностью, профессиональной компетентностью, продуманными стилями работы и строгой дисциплиной.

Хуанг обозначил пять приоритетов в области укрепления кадрового управления, начиная от соблюдения правильных критериев отбора и назначения должностных лиц и заканчивая укреплением способности должностных лиц проявлять инициативу и добиваться результатов.

Эти приоритеты отражают более широкое признание того, что цели развития Китая требуют не только разумной политики, но и должностных лиц, способных эффективно их реализовывать.

Ся Лу, эксперт по партийному строительству в Китайском университете Жэньминь, сказал: «Качество правящей партии напрямую формирует способность страны к модернизации, образуя четкую причинно-следственную цепочку: партийное самоуправление приводит к эффективному управлению, которое обеспечивает развитие, прокладывает путь к модернизации и в конечном итоге приводит к национальному омоложению».

Ся также отметил, что долгосрочное развитие страны требует организационной преемственности, поскольку инфраструктура, индустриализация, образование, техническая модернизация и сокращение масштабов нищеты часто зависят от политики, которая длится десятилетиями, а не от продолжительности жизни одной администрации.

Поэтому выбор и оценка должностных лиц имеет огромное значение, поскольку развитие зависит от бюрократии, способной учиться, внедрять и адаптировать, а не просто следовать процедурам.

articles.originalTitle: Analysts hail CPC's focus on self-governance, putting people first
articles.originalText: The fifth plenary session of the 20th Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee highlights the CPC's core strengths of self-governance and putting people first, attributes that underpin China's leapfrog development and provide useful governance references for political parties elsewhere, according to foreign analysts.
articles.originalFullText:
The fifth plenary session of the 20th Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee is presided over by the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee in Beijing, capital of China. The 20th CPC Central Committee held its fifth plenary session in Beijing from October 26 to October 29, 2026. /Xinhua

The fifth plenary session of the 20th Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee highlights the CPC's core strengths of self-governance and putting people first, attributes that underpin China's leapfrog development and provide useful governance references for political parties elsewhere, according to foreign analysts.

The 20th CPC Central Committee held its fifth plenary session from Monday to Thursday in Beijing, adopting a resolution on persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance.

Internal self-supervision and rigorous discipline have anchored the CPC through every historical phase – from revolution, the planned economy era, and reform and opening up to its ongoing advance into the digital age – said Kazbek Maigeldinov, chairman of the Association of China Researchers in Kazakhstan.

"Not every ruling party can proudly say that self-supervision and self-restraint are the cornerstones of its own building," Maigeldinov told CGTN in an interview.

Yet, for more than a century, the CPC has persevered in advancing self-regulation and anti-corruption efforts, a priority underscored prominently at the fifth plenary session of the 20th CPC Central Committee, he added.

It was noted at the session that stronger measures will be taken to improve the framework of Party regulations and institutions, ensure the enforcement of institutions and eliminate hidden rules.

"We must uphold the Party Constitution as the fundamental code of conduct for all Party members, deepen institutional reforms related to Party building, and integrate law-based governance of the country and regulation-based self-governance of the Party, thus providing strong institutional support for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance," read the communique issued following the session.

Maigeldinov said China has achieved leapfrog development in recent years and become an economic and tech powerhouse, which would not have been possible without the Party's institutional development and vigorous disciplinary safeguards.

"That will continue to help China achieve greater political and economic development on the international stage," he added.

Maigeldinov also expressed belief that the programmatic, theoretical commitments set out in the communique of the session will surely be translated into concrete outcomes.

The communique also underlined the importance of maintaining the Party's close bond with the people and following the Party's mass line in the new era.

"The Party tolerates no corruption, as it has no special interests of its own besides the interests of the working class and the greatest possible majority of the people," read the communique.

Sergey Gavrilov, a member of the Russian State Duma, the lower house of parliament, said upholding the mass line serves as an important guarantee for the steady advancement of the CPC's plans and the country's pursuit of basically realizing socialist modernization by 2035.

Gavrilov told CGTN that the CPC has fostered a governance system featuring plan-driven guidance and oversight for implementation through long-term practice.

This governance experience not only benefits China, but also offers valuable reference for political parties in countries that seek to serve their people's interests, pursue sovereignty and technological autonomy, and shake off legacies of Western colonialism, he said.

He emphasized that the CPC's strengths of striving relentlessly, serving the motherland and serving the people sustain the delivery of its plans.

That, he added, will also help advance the building of a community with a shared future for humankind and forge a shared sense of responsibility for humanity's development.
articles.title: Аналитики приветствуют сосредоточенность КПК на самоуправлении, ставя людей на первое место
articles.text: Пятое пленарное заседание Центрального комитета 20-й Коммунистической партии Китая (КПК) подчеркивает основные сильные стороны КПК в самоуправлении и ставит людей на первое место, атрибуты, которые лежат в основе развития скачка Китая и обеспечивают полезные рекомендации по управлению для политических партий в других местах, по мнению иностранных аналитиков.
articles.fullText:
Пятое пленарное заседание 20-го ЦК КПК проходит под председательством Политбюро ЦК КПК в Пекине, столице Китая. 20-е заседание ЦК КПК прошло в Пекине с 26 по 29 октября 2026 года. Синьхуа

Пятое пленарное заседание Центрального комитета 20-й Коммунистической партии Китая (КПК) подчеркивает основные сильные стороны КПК в самоуправлении и ставит людей на первое место, атрибуты, которые лежат в основе развития скачка Китая и обеспечивают полезные рекомендации по управлению для политических партий в других местах, по мнению иностранных аналитиков.

20-й ЦК КПК провел свое пятое пленарное заседание с понедельника по четверг в Пекине, приняв резолюцию о настойчивости с полным и строгим партийным самоуправлением.

Внутренний самоконтроль и строгая дисциплина закрепили КПК на каждом историческом этапе – от революции, эры плановой экономики, реформ и открытости до ее постоянного продвижения в цифровую эпоху, – сказал Казбек Майгельдинов, председатель Ассоциации исследователей Китая в Казахстане.

«Не каждая правящая партия может с гордостью сказать, что самоконтроль и самоограничение являются краеугольными камнями ее собственного здания», — сказал Майгельдинов в интервью CGTN.

Тем не менее, уже более века КПК упорно продвигает усилия по саморегулированию и борьбе с коррупцией, что было подчеркнуто на пятой пленарной сессии 20-го ЦК КПК.

На сессии было отмечено, что будут приняты более решительные меры по совершенствованию рамок партийных регламентов и институтов, обеспечению правоприменения институтов и устранению скрытых правил.

«Мы должны поддерживать Конституцию партии как основополагающий кодекс поведения для всех членов партии, углублять институциональные реформы, связанные с партийным строительством, и интегрировать основанное на законе управление страной и основанное на регулировании самоуправление партии, тем самым обеспечивая сильную институциональную поддержку для продолжения полного и строгого партийного самоуправления», — говорится в коммюнике, опубликованном по итогам сессии.

Майгельдинов сказал, что Китай в последние годы достиг скачка в развитии и стал экономическим и технологическим центром, что было бы невозможно без институционального развития партии и энергичных дисциплинарных гарантий.

«Это будет продолжать помогать Китаю добиваться большего политического и экономического развития на международной арене», — добавил он.

Майгельдинов также выразил уверенность в том, что программные, теоретические обязательства, изложенные в коммюнике сессии, обязательно будут переведены на конкретные результаты.

В коммюнике также подчеркивается важность сохранения тесной связи партии с народом и следования партийной линии масс в новую эпоху.

«Партия не терпит коррупции, так как у нее нет своих особых интересов, кроме интересов рабочего класса и максимально возможного большинства народа», — говорится в коммюнике.

Член Госдумы Сергей Гаврилов заявил, что поддержка массовой линии служит важной гарантией неуклонного продвижения планов КПК и стремления страны к реализации социалистической модернизации к 2035 году.

Гаврилов сказал CGTN, что КПК способствовал созданию системы управления, включающей руководство и надзор за осуществлением на основе плана на основе долгосрочной практики.

Этот опыт управления не только приносит пользу Китаю, но и предлагает ценную информацию для политических партий в странах, которые стремятся служить интересам своего народа, добиваться суверенитета и технологической автономии и избавиться от наследия западного колониализма.

Он подчеркнул, что сильные стороны КПК в неустанном стремлении служить Родине и народу поддерживают осуществление ее планов.

Это, добавил он, также поможет продвинуть создание сообщества с общим будущим для человечества и сформировать общее чувство ответственности за развитие человечества.
